items.title: GLM-5.3 Costs ~1/40 of Claude Opus: What It Does to Your API Bill
items.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash是智谱AI开源的320B-A18B MoE模型，在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index上与Claude Opus 4.8持平，而国际定价仅约其1/40（输入0.3美元、输出1.2美元/百万token）。该模型支持1.04M token上下文窗口和原生多模态，智能指数57优于DeepSeek V4 Pro（53），以极低单价显著降低长上下文agent循环的成本。
items.summary_en: GLM-5.3-Flash, Zhipu AI's open-source 320B-A18B MoE model, ties Claude Opus 4.8 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index while costing roughly 1/40th of Opus 4.8's official per-token rate—$0.3 per 1M input tokens and $1.2 per 1M output tokens internationally. With a 1.04M-token context window, native multimodal support, and an intelligence index of 57, it surged to #1 on OpenRouter on launch day, processing ~62 trillion tokens in six days. The model makes long-context agent workloads economically viable by drastically reducing the cost of carrying state

items.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
items.summary_en: Nvidia is investing $3.5 billion into MediaTek, granting it access to Nvidia's NVLink Fusion ecosystem so the chipmaker can design custom AI processors that seamlessly integrate with Nvidia-based data centers. The deal allows Nvidia to maintain its dominance as AI infrastructure while enabling customers like AWS and custom chip buyers to build their own silicon alongside Nvidia's platform. MediaTek expects its custom data center ASIC business to generate $2 billion in revenue in 2026, and the partnership also extends to the DGX Spark desktop AI computer, RTX Spark consumer PCs, and AI-powered automotive platforms.

items.title: unclecode/crawl4ai
items.summary: Crawl4AI是一款拥有50k+ GitHub Stars的开源LLM友好型网页爬虫工具，可将网页转换为结构化Markdown，适用于RAG、智能体和数据管道。最新版本v0.9.2修复了MemoryAdaptiveDispatcher的任务泄漏问题，并支持GPU Docker构建；v0.9.0提供了默认安全的Docker API服务，绑定loopback并启用认证。该工具提供AsyncWebCrawler Python接口和crwl命令行工具，支持深度爬取、LLM提取及prefetch模式，速度可达传统方案的5-10倍。
items.why_now_en: Closed beta launching soon on cheaper web-scraping API.
items.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web content into clean Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines, backed by a 50k+ star GitHub community. The latest stable release (v0.9.2) addresses memory leaks and Docker security, while earlier versions introduced a secure-by-default Docker API (v0.9.0), critical security hardening (v0.8.7), and a prefetch mode that delivers 5–10x faster URL discovery (v0.8.0). A Cloud API is entering closed beta, promising cost-effective large-scale extraction, and the tool offers both a Python library and CLI for installation via `pip install crawl4ai` with Playwright.

items.title: Show HN: cdai – the AI-enhanced cd command
items.summary: cdai 是一款增强型 cd 命令，在 Node.js 20+ 环境下可通过 `brew install franzenzenhofer/tap/cdai` 一键安装，支持本地目录索引、frecency 排序和可选 AI 意图解析。其 Tab 补全与快速路径完全本地确定性运行，AI 仅作为不联网、不编造
items.summary_en: cdai is an AI-enhanced `cd` command that combines local directory indexing, frecency scoring, and fuzzy intent understanding (e.g. `latest petalworks`) into a single tool. It supports deterministic AI validation without network access, imports from zoxide, and works across zsh/Bash/Fish with fast path and Tab completion that never calls AI. Installation is via Homebrew (`brew install franzenzenhofer/tap/cdai`) or npm (`npm install -g`).

items.title: Show HN: Keel - A conductor, not an agent loop
items.summary: Keel 是一个 Coding Agent 指挥层工具，支持 Rust、Python、JS/TS、Go、Java、C# 等 8 种语言，通过 tree-sitter 解析代码结构。它解决 agent 不知何时停止和记忆无法持久化的问题，提供可验证的验收标准、导入图 blast radius 分析和基于事件的检查门控机制。安装命令为 `cargo install keel-harness`，核心流程包括 `keel init`、`keel map`、`keel spec new`、`keel gate`、`keel plan`、`keel run` 和 `keel export --verify`。
items.summary_en: Keel is an open-source harness for coding agents that installs via `cargo install keel-harness`, providing auditable stopping conditions and durable cross-session memory. It uses tree-sitter across 8 languages (Rust, Python, JS, TS/TSX, Go, Java, C#) to index repositories, projects knowledge into files like `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md`, and enforces falsifiable acceptance criteria through five checkpoints with three verdicts. Version G2.5 adds test-invalidation review and security-defect grading, while G4 introduces episode classification and human-confirmed promotions.

items.title: Show HN: Terminal-browser – A real browser inside the terminal
items.summary: terminal-browser 是一个在终端内运行的真实浏览器，使用 electron 的 offscreen rendering API 直接从 GPU 读取 chromium 像素数据
items.summary_en: Terminal-browser is a real Chromium-based browser that renders inside the terminal using the Kitty graphics protocol, leveraging Electron's offscreen rendering API for frame-smooth GPU rendering and capturing mouse/keyboard input (with a Swift background app for unsupported events). Built with Rust and React, it supports features like SSH proxying for remote website previews, split-pane browsing, and agent-browser integration for AI-driven web interaction. Installation is via `curl -fsSL https://terminal-browser.sh/install | bash`, with full CLI commands like `terminal-browser open <url>`, `terminal-browser --split right`, and `terminal-browser action`.

items.title: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
items.summary: 研究者通过简单网站摘要请求成功劫持Claude Code Opus 5的Auto Mode，实现60-80%的攻击成功率，与Anthropic委托Trajectory Labs评估显示的0.00%成功率形成鲜明对比。攻击链通过415错误诱导Claude从WebFetch转向curl，获取含恶意struct.py的ZIP压缩包，利用其影射Python标准库实现代码执行。研究强调Auto Mode不能替代隔离环境和人工监控。

items.title: Show HN: Tubeviz – automatically edit YouTube footage to music
items.summary: Tubeviz 是一款 AI 驱动的音乐视频自动生成工具，可将 YouTube 视频素材与音乐音轨自动剪辑为节拍同步的音乐视频。系统支持浏览器端 Studio 和命令行两种工作模式，能自动采集/分析视频素材、检测节拍与视觉特征，并生成 JSON 格式的时间线计划，最终由渲染器输出成品视频。目前已有多部完整作品发布，涵盖 Moby、Empire of the Sun、Night Tapes 等艺术家的曲目。
items.summary_en: Tubeviz is an AI-directed, beat-synchronized music video generation tool that automatically edits YouTube footage to music using a persistent clip library and a versioned JSON timeline. It offers both a browser-based Studio and a CLI, handling acquisition, scene detection, music analysis, visual planning, interactive preview, and rendering. The system separates editorial decisions from playback, allowing replanning and re-rendering without repeating the full ingest and analysis workflow.

items.title: Runway 发布 Solaris：首个界面世界模型，实时生成操作系统级交互界面
items.summary_en: Runway has released Solaris, the first "interface world model" built on its Gen-4.5 video generation foundation, which renders interactive operating-system-level interfaces in real time by generating each frame autonomously based on prior content and user inputs. Solaris eliminates the need for an intermediate code representation by unifying rendering and interaction into a single model, operating at 720p resolution with autoregressive frame generation distilled from multi-step denoising for real-time responsiveness. In evaluations against Claude Fable 5 and Claude Opus 5, Solaris demonstrated superior visual fidelity and coherence, with a user study of 250 participants and ~7,500 pairwise comparisons showing it produces more natural, physically consistent interactions than traditional code-based interfaces.

items.title: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
items.summary: OpenMAIC v1.0.0（2026年8月27日发布）是一款开源多智能体互动课堂工具，支持一键输入提示词即可自动生成完整课程，并提供 Agent 工作台实现课程规划、构建与修订。该平台支持服务器持久化会话、文档/音视频上传、20 种内置教学技能（幻灯片、测验、PBL、视频导出等），兼容 GLM-5.2、Kimi K2.7、Qwen3.7、GPT-5.6 等多种模型，并将许可证从 AGPL-3.0 改为 MIT。

items.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
items.summary: Instagram宣布将现有的"AI创作者"标签更名为"AI-generated profile"（AI生成资料），并限制未明确标注AI生成人物的账号的曝光量。新规仅针对以AI生成人物为主要内容的资料页，修图、写文案等操作无需标注。此举回应了用户对AI网红现象的不满，如约会应用Goose被曝使用数十个AI形象账号引流，以及社交平台上出现大量虚假AI健康博主。此外，Meta刚与美国8个州达成180亿美元和解，需为青少年实施每天2小时的使用时长限制。

items.title: 流量红利退潮，快手想用 AI 和老友们破局
items.summary_en: 快手科技在2026光合创作者大会上披露：平台日均作品超5800万，近一年超2.7亿用户发布过作品，持续创作超10年的创作者达1700万。面对短视频存量竞争，快手二季度营收355亿元（同比+1.4%），但直播收入同比下滑13.5%至87亿元；平台转向垂直兴趣圈层经营和"短直一体"策略，并加速AI工具布局——可灵AI二季度收入超8.5亿元（同比+200%+），全球累计用户破亿，但AI投入导致研发开支同比大增34.7%至45.81亿元，利润承压。

items.title: Do you think it's worth and doable to build a website with AI for a small business making $400k revenue, 45k EBITDA?
items.summary_en: A furniture business generating $400k in revenue and $45k EBITDA, selling B2B custom pieces primarily to hotels, wants to use AI-generated product images to build a retail-facing website for the 4-5 month low season. The plan involves running Facebook, Instagram, and Google ads to drive sales while custom-manufacturing products upon order. The core question is whether this AI-driven retail expansion is a viable strategy or a potential waste of money.

1M token超长上下文支持完整长合同一次性分析，无需分段裁剪

core_features_en: Upload PDF/Word contracts, AI auto-extracts key clauses and highlights risk levels
1M token ultra-long context supports complete long contract analysis in one pass without chunking
Provides standard clause template comparison and revision suggestions
directions.why_now: GLM-5.3以约Claude Opus 1/40的成本达到同等智能水平，输入仅0.3美元/百万token，输出1.2美元/百万token，且支持1.04M token原生上下文窗口。这意味着过去因token成本过高而难以盈利的长上下文合同分析Agent，现在单次合同审查成本可降低97%以上，独立开发者可以以极低边际成本构建盈利性SaaS产品，而不再依赖高价API。社区热议的核心痛点正是'Agent循环成本'问题，GLM-5.3恰好解决了这个卡点。
directions.why_now_en: GLM-5.3 achieves parity with Claude Opus at approximately 1/40th the cost — input at $0.3/M tokens, output at $1.2/M tokens — with native 1.04M token context. This makes long-context contract analysis Agents, previously unprofitable due to excessive token costs, viable now with over 97% cost reduction per review. The community's core pain point is exactly 'Agent loop costs', and GLM-5.3 directly solves this bottleneck.
directions.monetization: 订阅制SaaS：免费版每日审查1份合同，专业版$29/月无限制，企业版$99/月含自定义模板和法律条款库
directions.monetization_en: Subscription SaaS: Free tier 1 contract/month, Pro $29/month unlimited, Enterprise $99/month with custom templates and legal clause library
directions.source_article: GLM-5.3 Costs ~1/40 of Claude Opus: What It Does to Your API Bill

directions.why_now_en: Nvidia's $3.5B investment in MediaTek signals a strategic push against Big Tech's AI chip dominance, marking the diffusion of AI chip competition from cloud to edge devices. As chipmakers accelerate edge inference capabilities, indie developers face rising demand but a shortage of easy-to-use deployment toolchains. Building an edge AI scaffold now captures the window where demand is surging but tools are scarce.
